target.title: fix(clawhub): keep request deadline through response body
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a gap where ClawHub request deadlines were cleared at HTTP headers, leaving stalled or dripping response bodies unbounded. Fixes a compatibility issue where the previous revision applied the same 30s wall-clock deadline to large (up to 256 MiB) archive downloads, which could terminate a healthy progressing transfer.

## Why This Change Was Made

`clawhubRequest` previously cleared its `AbortController` timer as soon as `fetch` returned headers, so `readResponseWithLimit` per-chunk idle detection was the only body bound — a slow drip could keep resetting chunk-idle and hang forever.

This change keeps the wall-clock deadline through body consumption for all paths, but archive downloads (`downloadClawHubPackageArchive`, `downloadClawHubSkillArchive`, `downloadClawHubSkillArchiveUrl`, `downloadClawHubGitHubSkillArchive`) release it after confirming `response.ok` via a `release()` call. Non-2xx archive responses do NOT release the deadline, so error-body reads stay bounded by the wall-clock. Per-chunk idle detection in `readClawHubResponseBytes` still bounds stalls for all paths.

Non-goals: changing `readClawHubResponseBytes` or `readResponseWithLimit` internals, changing the default 30s budget.

Collision check: no open PR on `src/infra/clawhub.ts` with overlapping deadline semantics.

## User Impact

- Stalled or continuously dripping ClawHub metadata/JSON responses fail with the request wall-clock deadline instead of hanging.
- Archive downloads (skill, package, ClawPack, GitHub source) are not cut off at the 30s metadata budget; a progressing transfer completes while per-chunk idle detection still terminates stalled bodies.
- Non-2xx archive error bodies (e.g. CDN returns 500 with slow body) stay bounded by the wall-clock deadline — the deadline is only released after confirming response.ok.
- Retry, error-body, and JSON paths keep the full-body wall-clock.

## Evidence

Exact head: `d8aae19e2f0b95f69d55b0fad8a3af285cdee241`

`oxfmt --check src/infra/clawhub.ts src/infra/clawhub.test.ts` — passed.
`git diff --check` — clean.

### Tests

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/clawhub.test.ts -- --run --reporter=verbose
```

```
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > keeps the ClawHub request deadline through stalled bodies after headers 53ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > aborts ClawHub JSON bodies that drip past the request deadline 52ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > times out and cancels stalled skill archive body reads 11ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > times out and cancels stalled package archive body reads 8ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > times out and cancels stalled ClawPack artifact body reads 8ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > lets a progressing archive body survive past the request deadline 6ms
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts > clawhub helpers > keeps archive error bodies under the request wall-clock deadline 59ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  84 passed | 2 skipped (86)
```

### Loopback proof

Real `http.createServer` loopback + real `fetch` + real production functions (`searchClawHubSkills` / `downloadClawHubSkillArchive`). No mock fetch, no fake timers.

```bash
HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node --import tsx proof-clawhub-deadline.mts
```

```
--- Case 1: Dripping metadata body with wall-clock deadline ---
  ok: dripping metadata body rejects (not hangs)
  ok: error mentions timeout or abort
  ok: elapsed is near timeout (150-2000ms)
  info: case=metadata-drip elapsed_ms=220 timeout_ms=200

--- Case 2: Progressing archive body with releaseAfterHeaders ---
  ok: progressing archive survives past wall-clock deadline
  ok: archive download completed (not truncated)
  info: case=archive-progress elapsed_ms=240 timeout_ms=100

--- Case 3: Stalled archive body with chunk-idle timeout ---
  ok: stalled archive rejects (not hangs)
  ok: error mentions stalled or idle
  ok: elapsed is within a few multiples of chunk-timeout
  info: case=archive-stall elapsed_ms=108 timeout_ms=100

--- Case 4: Dripping non-2xx archive error body with wall-clock deadline ---
  ok: dripping archive error body rejects (not hangs)
  ok: error contains HTTP status
  ok: elapsed is bounded (not hanging)
  info: case=archive-error-drip elapsed_ms=203 timeout_ms=200 error=ClawHub /api/v1/download failed (400): Bad Request

--- Case 5: Negative control — idle-only stays unsettled ---
  ok: without wall-clock deadline, drip stays unsettled past 400ms
  info: case=negative-control outcome=still-pending elapsed_ms=401

=== Summary ===
head=d8aae19e2f0b95f69d55b0fad8a3af285cdee241
node=v22.22.0
ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 12 passed, 0 failed
```

- **Metadata drip (200ms)**: 15ms continuous drip → rejects in 220ms. Wall-clock deadline bounds body, not just headers.
- **Archive progress (100ms + releaseAfterHeaders)**: 25ms chunk drip → completes in 240ms (>100ms). `release()` correctly releases the timer after headers so a progressing transfer finishes.
- **Archive stall (100ms)**: single chunk then stall → rejects in 108ms with stalled/idle error. Chunk-idle timeout catches stalled bodies after the wall-clock is released.
- **Archive error body drip (200ms, NEW)**: non-2xx (400) with continuous 15ms drip → rejects in 203ms. `release()` is NOT called for non-2xx responses so the wall-clock deadline stays active through error-body reads.
- **Negative control**: 15ms drip with effectively no wall-clock (`timeoutMs: 999_999`) → still pending at 401ms. Proves old code path has no wall-clock bound.

### Mutation check

Case 5 (negative control) also serves as mutation proof: with `timeoutMs: 999_999` the wall-clock never fires, and a continuously dripping body stays unsettled past 400ms — this is exactly the pre-fix behavior where the timer was cleared at headers and only chunk-idle remained. With the fix at normal timeout, the wall-clock fires within budget (Cases 1, 4).

### Contract

| Path | Wall-clock | Chunk-idle | Stall bound |
|------|-----------|------------|-------------|
| Metadata/JSON (`fetchJson`, `parseClawHubJsonBody`) | request deadline | request deadline | wall-clock |
| Error bodies (`readErrorBody`) | request deadline | request deadline | wall-clock |
| Skill card (`fetchClawHubSkillCard`) | request deadline | request deadline | wall-clock |
| Promotions feed (`fetchClawHubPromotionsFeed`) | request deadline | request deadline | wall-clock |
| **Archive downloads (200)** | **released at headers** | request deadline | **chunk-idle** |
| **Archive error bodies (non-2xx)** | **request deadline** | request deadline | **wall-clock** |

### Not tested

Live ClawHub CDN against real archive endpoints — requires real ClawHub auth token.
